title: LearnerReplay
description: POST /replay of the Jetson learner (D38): what a candidate automation would have done on the journal's last days. Only simple automations replay (state / time / sun / numeric_state triggers; state / time / sun / numeric_state / and / or / not conditions; service calls on entities); anything else is listed in `unsupported` and nothing is counted. An estimate from what happened by hand, never proof.

automation.description: an HA automation config (triggers, conditions, actions)

outcomes.description: per entity it would have set: right = a person set the same within 10 min after; no_op = it already was; wrong = nobody did while someone was active (a change by hand anywhere within 30 min); unobserved = nobody was active
